content.summary: Work management platform Asana (NYSE:ASAN) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 9.3% year on year to $201 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $205 million at the midpoint, 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.07 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
